description:
Andrew Garfield and Claire Foy lead a modern family into a world of ever-changing magical lands in the official trailer for THE MAGIC FARAWAY TREE (2026). When the Thompson children discover an enchanted tree behind their new countryside home, every climb opens a doorway to another fantastical realm — and the eccentric characters who live at the top.

Based on Enid Blyton's beloved book series. Directed by Ben Gregor, written by Simon Farnaby (Paddington 2). In US cinemas August 21, 2026.

Starring: Andrew Garfield, Claire Foy, Nicola Coughlan, Rebecca Ferguson, Jessica Gunning, Nonso Anozie

Enjoy advanced 4K Upscaling and HDR-10 mastering across future trailers. Stay tuned for more.
